name: meridian-doc-consultant
works_with: Any agent that supports `npx skills`, plus Antigravity
short: Answers your questions about Google's Meridian marketing mix modeling by looking up and citing the official docs.
what: Meridian is Google's open source framework for marketing mix modeling, which measures how each channel drives sales or other KPIs. This skill has your agent answer questions about Meridian concepts, parameters and best practices. It finds the right pages on developers.google.com/meridian, reads them and cites the URLs. It doesn't write code or run models; Meridian has other skills for that.
who: Analysts and marketers who use Meridian, or are weighing it up, and want answers they can check against the docs. If you don't do marketing mix modeling, skip it.
needs: Web access for your agent, so it can fetch pages from developers.google.com/meridian

steps.title: Install all the Meridian skills
steps.text: This installs the doc consultant along with the model building, visualisation, budget and scenario planner skills.

steps.title: Ask a Meridian question
steps.text: Your agent uses the skill when you ask about a Meridian topic. Its answer lists the doc pages it read.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: "In Meridian, what are knots and how should I set them?"

watch: The docs aren't in the repo or the Python package. Without web access the skill gives you the page links and doesn't present unverified details as documented guidance.
The skill tells the agent not to give numbers or recommendations from general knowledge, only from pages it actually read.
